title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Otori Houseworker
rows.Line: Please wait here. He will be with you shortly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, um...
Thank you for taking the time to meet with me like this.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, what is it that you wish to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To put it bluntly, I have a favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to do ambassadorial performances once more?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Ambassadorial performances?
Why this all of the sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They were a way for us to perform alongside different actors at various locations other than the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The show we did with the ArcLand troupe in particular allowed me to grow considerably as an actor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I was hoping to figure out a way to perform somewhere besides the Wonder Stage from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. In order to grow as an actor...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, I understand that many guests visit Phoenix Wonderland just to see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I wish to do everything I can for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it wouldn't have to be ambassadorial performances. I am simply asking for more opportunities to do shows at different locations. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I believe this will not only help me achieve my goals, but also make the Wonder Stage an even more magnificent place than it already is.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I see.
What you say does make sense.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, that means...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, I'm afraid now is not the time for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As we discussed before, the goal of those ambassadorial performances was to boost Phoenix Wonderland's attendance figures. And your troupe made that a reality.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As a result, and as you said yourself, many of our guests now wish to see you perform specifically at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, we do not wish to disappoint them by having you perform elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Also, from our perspective as the park's operators, those ambassadorial performances were an investment that did not have profit in mind.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Everything from booking venues to putting schedules together costs money. More than I suspect you're imagining...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: The performances succeeded in promoting Phoenix Wonderland, so there is no longer any need for you to perform elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I understand where they're coming from.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I am an employee of the park. Although having a part-time job that enables me to grow as an actor would be optimal for me....)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I know they have a lot to deal with as the park's operators, and I'm not really in a position to be asking them to help me achieve my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I know that. But I...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It may be difficult right now, but an opportunity to do something like that again may arise in the future...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, for now, please try to focus on performing at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Understood...
I apologize for asking so much of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I agree that it wouldn't be right to disappoint all the guests who are coming to the park to see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'll give this some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, we do want to support you in any way we can...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we're the park's operators, so it'd be unfair of us to give one employee special treatment.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As such, we can't always cater for your interests, regardless of how much we wish we could. When that happens...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You may be forced to make some tough decisions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some tough decisions...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, thank you for meeting with me. I know it's late. I'll see you at the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Take care.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I knew that we'd be having this conversation sooner or later... But not this soon.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I doubt there was much we could've done about that. I mean, the show he did with everyone from ArcLand really must've had a significant effect on him.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Which means... We can keep trying to buy time, but we probably won't be able to stop him. In time...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I suspect that he'll say he wants to leave the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: For now, let's keep doing what we can. Ideally, we'll be able to come to some sort of mutual agreement.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, if he decides to leave, even after we do everything in our power to convince him to stay, then...
A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Okay, that's enough warming up!
Let's take a quick break and get right back to it!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It feels like it's been so long since we spent so much time at the Wonder Stage like this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between our ambassadorial performances coming to a close and that series of shows we did during New Year's, we've been quite busy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But that was super duper fun!
We got to do shows at the beach, the top of a mountain, a ski resort and the mall!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In hindsight, our schedule ended up being pretty hectic...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: However, I was glad to see that we were able to put on such wonderful performances.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree...
And above all else, Lion Dance Robot seemed incredibly happy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
It was so great to see our shows put smiles on all those people's faces!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's keep doing everything we can at the Wonder Stage to make as many people as we can smile☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, let's.
So, why don't we start discussing our next show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been thinking about attending this acting workshop to hone my skills...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, the Wonder Stage takes top priority, but I thought I should tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A workshop...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on!
What's an acting workshop?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're interactive classes where you can learn by doing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, what you actually do depends on how it's taught. Care to share more details?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Over the course of a month, we'll cover the theory and practice of a number of skills including vocal projection, acting techniques for various situations and more.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's being run by a famous director, and apparently we'll also be learning action sequences including stage combat. I'm sure it'll be very inspiring.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
That sounds super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It sounds like the real deal...
What made you decide to do this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel like I learn so much whenever I perform alongside people I don't normally perform with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our New Year's shows were no exception... However, my acting skills improved significantly after performing with everyone from ArcLand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, in order to give myself more opportunities to grow as an actor, I decided to look for ways to keep honing my craft.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, where did you hear about this workshop? The internet?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I found many that caught my interest but couldn't decide which one to sign up for.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I've been hoping to meet more people who are just as serious about acting. I actually asked Asahi about this since he probably knows a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Asahi does seem like a person who'd give good advice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. He actually went through this workshop and said that it was very educational. He was even kind enough to tell me that it was being held again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I signed up for it straight away.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean Asahi's gonna be there too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, he said he already committed to performing in a very important show during that time. I'll be going alone this time around.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure how I'll fare since it's going to be full of experienced actors... However, for the sake of my dream, I am ready to face this trial by fire that lies before me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Trial by fire? I don't think you have to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But for the sake of your dream...
Yeah, I get how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree with what you're saying, Tsukasa. This is a wonderful opportunity that you should take full advantage of. Please, don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
Especially since you're gonna be a star in the future!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, I'll be rooting for you!
Go Tsukasa! We believe in you☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, your encouragement is much appreciated!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, when is this workshop taking place?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's scheduled to start next week.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, that soon?
Isn't that gonna conflict with our practice schedule?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I said earlier, the Wonder Stage still takes priority. After all, a true star and troupe leader can handle both simultaneously.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's fine, but...
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Practicing for both is likely going to take a hefty physical toll. If you ever feel too strained, please be sure to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, no worries there.
I've been keeping in tip-top shape just for this sort of situation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time. It's already this late.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for taking up so much of our time. Let's regroup and get back to discussing our next show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
Tsukasa seems so sparkly today. Just seeing that put a smile on my face.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And he's really doing everything he can to make his dream come true. I really hope he does end up becoming a star...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know you can do it, Tsukasa♪
A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Morning, Emu.
You're here pretty early again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, Rui, good wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, that just leaves Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. He said it's the first day of that workshop he was talking about, so he's probably going to be here a bit later than usual.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He'll be at that workshop until noon and come here to practice afterwards. I have to say, it's a tough schedule...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: *Roar*
se_event_shining_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Apologies for being late!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But you're not.
Practice doesn't start for another fifteen minutes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, he's always here early, so this may feel quite late to him by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today was the first day of that workshop, right?! Well? What was it like?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I'm glad you asked!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we have some time before practice, allow me to tell you! If I could sum it up in one word, it was...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Extraordinary!
There's no other way to describe it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Coool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even when we introduced ourselves, it turned into an acting exercise. I remained focused throughout, and the tension made it all the more stimulating!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You had to act out your self-introduction...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How does that work...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you simply do a self-introduction in place of your own self introduction!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that isn't helping.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... How do I put it...?
After telling each other our real names, we were asked to recite the same self-introduction as everyone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “My name is Taro Sato. I work as a member of the Third Sales Division for Acme Corporation, and I mainly work as a business consultant for our clients. It's a pleasure to meet all of you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...is what we were asked to recite.
And each person gave a different rendition of it based on their own style. For example...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Mine was...
“My name is Taro Sato! I work as a member of the Third Sales Division for Acme Corporation!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
One person's was like...
“My name is...Taro...Sato... I work as a member of the Third Sales Division...for Acme Corporation...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa!
So it can sound really different depending on who's saying it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely.
Conversely, it's harder to make a lasting impression if you don't have a distinct style...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thus, it was a test of our acting skills.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Interesting...
That sounds really hard, but also really fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. I'm particularly interested in hearing more about what the director hosting this workshop is like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. He's a very unique individual, and the exercises he had us do were just as intriguing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I had no issues with that since I'm already more than used to working with such a director!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's all thanks to you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure how I'm supposed to feel about that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If your first day was this action-packed, you must be looking forward to how the rest of this workshop's going to go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I can't wait to see what else we're going to do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also, that reminds me.
Apparently, on the last day, we're supposed to put on a performance at a small auditorium that's being rented out for this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we're allowed to invite guests, so I hope you'll come by to watch!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! We get to see your guys' show?! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you already know what you'll be performing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, but we have a few candidates lined up. The director said that he'll make a decision once he's seen what everyone is capable of.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, interesting...
Yes, that would probably make for a better show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm also very much looking forward to seeing your hard work come to fruition.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
As I!
Just you wait! It'll be an opportunity for you to all see how much I've grown as an actor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, it's about time for practice. Wanna get started?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
How do you feel, Tsukasa? Ready for practice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More than ready! If anything, I couldn't be in a more perfect condition! I'm all warmed up and ready to get started whenever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You certainly sound like it.
Then, let's start with the opening scene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Sage
rows.Line: “Ah, this must be the sword. The legends state that whoever is able to pull it from this stone is destined to become a hero who saves the world.”

rows.Speaker: Onlooker
rows.Line: “And yet, no one has ever been able to do so. Not even the burliest of men or the most renowned masters of the blade.”

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: “Which is why everyone here believes that it was created to never be pulled out.”

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: “Or maybe it's just trying to tell us that a hero who can save the world hasn't appeared yet.”

rows.Speaker: Sage
rows.Line: “Hehe. She believes in such fairytales. How cute.”

rows.Speaker: Sage
rows.Line: “However, you are one of her brethren, and you believe that you have the power to free this sword from its prison... Do you not?”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line:
“I do not know.
I am no swordsman, nor do I possess the strength to break stone.”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “At the same time, how long has this feeling lingered within me...?”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “This inexplicable compulsion to protect the world. It feels as though it has been branded into my soul...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (His acting's different compared to normal. For some reason...it's like what he's doing makes perfect sense.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When read as is, not many people would think to recite that line in the way he just did...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The thought of the weight of the world resting on one's shoulders usually compels the reader to feel very impassioned.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, Tsukasa chose to...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Tsukasa!
I really loved what you did just now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So did I.
It was a captivating performance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
All this praise is starting to make me feel antsy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your performance was so convincing. How did you come up with that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I wasn't happy with my portrayal when I was practicing at home...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I asked one of the other workshop attendees and they said, “I'd try practicing somewhere similar to where it takes place.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Somewhere similar...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, but I didn't understand what they meant at first. So, I decided to start by taking a literal interpretation and performing by the side of a big boulevard.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, the hero from this scene is still a penniless shoe shiner that everyone was too scared to go near...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is understandable...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, that allowed me to see how he truly feels. He's incredibly lonely. He realizes that he is but a miniscule part of a large society.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He has no idea what he can do in or for this world. And yet, this overwhelming sense of duty has been lingering within him for as long as he can remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I believe this role involves him wanting to see whether or not that feeling means anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think he's dealing with an internal battle, where his desire to know is clashing with his fear of disappointment...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which led to what we just saw.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just based on the script, I was under the impression that most people would feel compelled to give an impassioned performance of sorts. However, Tsukasa, your interpretation makes perfect sense.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was really awesome!
So awesome that I almost forgot my own lines!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, music to my ears!
It just goes to show that training elsewhere is very important!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've actually been looking for another workshop to attend once this one finishes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also...
It'd be great to make a guest appearance with another troupe!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A guest appearance...?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's when a member of one troupe performs in a show being put on by another troupe. In other words, a special guest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you wanna perform with another troupe...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to try whatever I can if it means becoming a better actor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, there's no need to worry. I plan to do that while also doing performances at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
I'm okay! There's nothing wrong!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(What happened just now...?
Things felt really weird for a second there.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa wants to make his dream come true, so it's only natural for him to say that he wants to perform with a different troupe.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, that's why he's attending that workshop, and why I've been supportive of that...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What is this feeling...?)
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
That was really fun! We got so much done today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we did. Also...
I believe we were able to make such strides because of you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks for teaching us those tricks for improving our articulation and body language.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! Anytime!
I was simply sharing the fruits of my labors with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But is it okay for you to teach us this stuff? I mean, we're not actually in that workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
We were even told to teach others these techniques since the goal of the workshop is to make the world of theatre a better place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that's very generous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu?
You seem anxious. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? No, nothing's wrong...!
I was just replaying what we just did in my head because you guys were so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, we did so much during practice that I'm starting to get really hungry.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, wanna go to our usual diner?
Honami told me that they just added some seasonal parfaits that are really yummy☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really?
I'm kinda hungry too, so that might be nice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Seasonal parfaits?
Actually, I think Saki mentioned the same thing. I've been meaning to try it, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you have a prior engagement?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, we're supposed to put on some one-man performances tomorrow and I need to practice mine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay... That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, you won't be able to come today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry, but you'll have to enjoy those parfaits without me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...
Good luck, Tsukasa!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, these are all their new parfaits?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
Tsukasa was clearly excited about that workshop, but now he's there and not here, I don't feel quite right.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But why? I've been rooting for him this entire time, haven't I...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, everything's fine!
I think I'm a little sleepy because we did so much during practice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you're right! There are so many different kinds of parfaits! Do you know what you're gonna get, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me...? I was thinking about getting this lemon one. I don't see this flavor much and it looks really refreshing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's so you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm gonna get the strawberry one!
It's so cute how the ice cream's shaped like stars☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is really cute.
I was actually having trouble deciding between these two.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, you can have some of mine!
In return, I want some of yours, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you getting, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The 100% beef Salisbury steak.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you're not getting a parfait?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was going to, but I started craving something that wasn't sweet after going through the menu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then I'll take those veggies for you like I always do!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you're getting a parfait. Isn't that gonna taste weird? Well, I guess whatever makes you both happy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, let's hit the bell since we all know what we're getting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna press it!
Ding! Ding! Ding♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're shouting louder than it...

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Here you go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The star ice cream on mine's really cute, but so is yours, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And your Salisbury steak looks so good, Rui! Is it just me or is it bigger than usual...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems that they made some minor changes to the menu. Unfortunately, that also appears to have led to an increase in vegetables that I'd rather not eat...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's okay! Tsukasa and I'll gobble them all up! But he doesn't like bell peppers, so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right. Tsukasa isn't here today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel...
It is rare for him to be absent.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, even though he's not here, it feels like he is. Talk about having a strong presence...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But didn't this happen once before when Tsukasa said he wanted to practice on his own?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, for “A Pianist Named Thorpe”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought I asked too much of him that time, but it seems that he's been trying even harder recently...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. He's even figured out a way to practice for both the Wonder Stage and his workshop like he said he would.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like he's been able to absorb everything he's learned and grow so much from it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It really is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But seeing how he's been doing recently made me want to not fall behind.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm scared of working with people I don't know, but learning new skills and techniques sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I kinda want to try attending one of those workshops.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I think that's a good choice if it'll help make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may not be able to gather together as much as we used to with Tsukasa gone and you soon-to-be, Nene. It's going to feel a little lonely without you two.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Lonely...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait, this feeling... Am I...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Feeling lonely...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I knew we'd eventually end up going our separate ways when we were stranded on that desert island.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I knew all that...
But I thought it was really far into the future.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They're all thinking about their futures already.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not just Tsukasa.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Nene and Rui too...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We might have to split up sooner than I was expecting...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, in order for them to pursue their dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What are you spacing out for?
Your ice cream's has melted so much it's dripping onto the plate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
O-Oh no! You're right!
It even got on my clothes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Here, use this towel. It's gonna stain if you don't get it off right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank you so much, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's the conundrum with parfaits.
If you don't eat it quickly, they start melting on you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your stars seem to be no exception.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
My stars...
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, nice work today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, our practice couldn't have gone better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you gonna work on assignments for your workshop after this, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, we weren't given any assignments...
But I would like to practice for the performance we'll be doing on the last day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The performance on the last day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also, that reminds me.
Apparently, on the last day, we're supposed to put on a performance at a small auditorium that's being rented out for this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we're allowed to invite guests, so I hope you'll come by to watch!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Yeah, he mentioned that...
And that time, I...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! We get to see your guys' show?! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But now, I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Practice for it? Does that mean you know what you'll be performing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, however... You'll have to wait until the day of to find out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? You're not gonna tell us?
Did the director tell you guys not to or something...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, this is my own decision!
Because that makes things more interesting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think it's a nice way to build up the excitement.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
See?! Exactly!
So, here are your platinum tickets to see the show...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, Nene, here you are... And...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is yours, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Get ready to see an incredible performance! I guarantee that you won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I can't wait to see how you perform your role, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah, this is fine...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm happy that Tsukasa's learning so much and becoming a better actor.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, I should be happy for him as he chases after his dream...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (There's no time for me to feel sad or lonely because I know the day is coming when we have to go our separate ways...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's coming, so...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Look at me...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is supposed to be a happy moment... I wish I could just accept it.)
Several dozen minutes later
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's already this late.
I feel like time's been moving very fast recently.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...
Um, Rui? About Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, something seems to be bothering her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So you noticed too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think a part of her doesn't like how Tsukasa is performing somewhere other than the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She didn't seem to be her usual self when you and I mentioned that it could be fun to go elsewhere to learn more about theatre and acting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I doubt that she's against the idea of us performing elsewhere... I mean, she was all for Tsukasa attending that workshop when he first told us about it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
True...
She even said that she was looking forward to seeing his show at the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, what's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is just my guess...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I think Emu's starting to see that we won't be able to stay together as we take steps towards making each of our dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Is that why...?
She's sad about us going our separate ways?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's what I suspect.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that's way down the road, and that's life, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your words say one thing, but your face says different.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Don't stare at me like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For all we know, that time may be coming sooner than we realize...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, this is a tough one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As much as I'd like to cheer Emu up, there's no clear solution to this problem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But we can't just leave her like this.
There has to be something we can do for her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, what would be best for her...?

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: <Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Len...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, Nene's here too!
Sorry for dropping in without any notice!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <KAITO wants to ask you some directing questions regarding our next show, Rui, so he asked me to come get you.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is something wrong...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And we're sorta not sure what to do about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind if we talked to all of you about it? Also, I'll be more than happy to help KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay!
Then, I'll let the others know!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We'll be waiting for you guys in SEKAI!>
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
Emu's starting to feel lonely because she thinks that you guys are gonna split up soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Which is why we want to cheer her up somehow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, it's inevitable that we'll have to go our separate ways to pursue our dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we're not sure how to talk to her about it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that may be tricky...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Regardless of what we say, it's up to Emu to come to terms with it by herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By herself...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't wanna see Emu all sad and lonely!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We should do what we can to get her to smile like she usually does!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right...
I know how easy it is to fall deeper and deeper into this sort of abyss, so I'm very worried.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know you were capable of feeling sad, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, what's that supposed to mean?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, our first step may be to help cheer her up by thinking of something that she can enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That she can enjoy...?
So, something that she likes doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What does Emu like to do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Explore her neighborhood and going to taiyaki shops...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
She said that she really loves playing video games with you, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you two went shopping together the other day, she was as happy and talkative as ever☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You do seem to mean quite a lot to her, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's just us being friends...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, what does Emu care about the most...? I've gone through a lot of possibilities in my head, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland, no...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that may be our best option.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup yup! Especially since you guys are all there and mean the world to her☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, how about hanging out together with her at Phoenix Wonderland together...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, hanging out with the people I care most about somewhere I really love would definitely put a smile on my face!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Just thinking about doing that in SEKAI with everyone makes me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It makes me...super happy and excited☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we're there pretty much every day because of our shows... We wouldn't be going very far. You really believe that's going to make her feel better...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Regardless of what we say, it's up to Emu to come to terms with it by herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, that may not be as bad an idea as it may sound...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But not great?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, Len, he's saying that it's a very good idea.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
So, I was able to help you two?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you gave us some wonderful advice. I'd like to ask Emu about this as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, wait. Nene, you may need to contact her since I have to stay here to help KAITO with his show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's fine...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sorry, Rui.
I wish I could've picked a better time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's okay since you all helped us out just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
Can we join you guys when you all hang out together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, sure. I'm sure Emu would like that too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks!
I really hope we can cheer Emu up and turn her frown upside down☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm excited about this too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is this really gonna help cheer her up...?)
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “And so, the girl and her father looked up towards the boat-shaped cloud in the night sky, together.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd been a while since I last read this, but I still love it. It's like an exciting dream, but it's not a dream...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what if we put on a show based on this story...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A message?
From who? It's so late...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Nene!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Sorry, I know this is sudden. But since we're gonna have some time to spare before Tsukasa's show, how would you feel about hanging out together at Phoenix Wonderland that day?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <We've been so busy lately that I think we deserve a little reward. Rui said he'll come, so let me know if you also want to.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is great!
We get to hang out together at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What should we go on? The roller coaster for one. I also wanna go on the fish coaster, and at night...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're gonna see Tsukasa's show...
It's probably gonna be super duper amazing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Practicing at the Wonder Stage while attending that workshop has to be super hard, but he's managing really well. So well that he's been sparkling during practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, when we see Tsukasa in his super, ultra-powered up state...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm so scared...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Seeing that is going to be like a sign that we're gonna have to say goodbye to each other soon.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Because of that...
A part of me is having trouble rooting for Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really don't like that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean I'll start feeling the same way about the others...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... I...
A few days later
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Fun, fun PXL! Such a happy place♪
Boom, boom, boom! Here comes a big parade♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope Nene and Rui get here soon. We're gonna have sooo much fun today☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, you're here early.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Nene! Hi, Rui!
You're finally here! I've been waiting for ages!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, we're here ten minutes early...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it's good to see that you're so excited.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because we have some good news to tell you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Good news?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <He's talking about us!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Rui and Nene told us what was going on, so we decided to join you guys! Let's do lots and lots of stuff together today☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! Miku and the others are here too!
This is so cool! It almost feels like my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I wish Tsukasa could also be here... It's too bad that he has to be in that show!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <*Gasp*>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wh-What do I do?!
I think I said too much!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sure Tsukasa will be able to join us another time in the future...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
Two trips means twice the fun, right☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And I'm sure Tsukasa's doing his best right now to make sure he puts on a good performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, after Tsukasa does his show, we should come back again!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start going on some rides! Are there any that you guys wanna go on?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
About that...
I came up with a plan that should let us visit as many rides and attractions as we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thanks, Rui! You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, get ready!
It's time to GO, GO, GO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <E-Emu, wait!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Geez...
She hasn't even heard your plan yet, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She seems happy on the surface, but she still seems partially preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I really hope this helps cheer her up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Whoa! Emu, this is so cool☆
The world's spinning round and round!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<This is fun!
Let's keep spinning faster and faster!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<What...? The drop's this high?
I need more time to mentally prepare...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Waaaahhhh!!!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whew...
All the rides we've been on so far have had big drops, but this train ride seems nice and gentle!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but the end of this one also...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh? No, don't tell me...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Again?! You've gotta be kidding me!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, we got to go on the three most popular rides in the park!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!
That was so much fun☆>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was fun... But...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like it if we could go on something a little more gentle next...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What? I wanna keep going on the fun rides!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Me too!
The ones that go zing-zang-zoom!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<How are you guys okay?
My eyes won't stop spinning...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we've been at it for quite a while now, so it may be a good time to take a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm pretty tired after being flung around so much. A drink sounds nice right about now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go around to the spots where the shops are and take a look at each of them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The popcorn differs depending on where you buy it, so seeing what's available should be fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, is that true?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, the popcorn here's really famous and comes in all sorts of different flavors♪ Everything from your classic salty butter to fizzy soda!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Soda popcorn...? I'm having a hard time imagining how that tastes, but it sounds very tasty, not to mention fizzy.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miku, since you and the others won't be able to have any right now, we'll buy some to bring back later. Let's walk around and see if any catch your eye.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, this will give us a chance to do a lap of the park.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A lap of the park...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then! Let's start with the closest one! It's over this way!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The soda-flavored popcorn looked really good. I can't wait for you guys to bring some over to SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And thank you for waiting in that long line to buy it.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No problem. Besides, we want all of you to try it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, there do seem to be more people visiting today compared to before...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, there are.
I saw a lot of people going to the other shop as well.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's just giant lines left and right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it because today's a holiday?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That may be playing a role...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I think it's because the park is simply attracting more visitors...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: More visitors...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. More people began to visit after we put on more and more shows at the Wonder Stage... However, lately, something seems different about the park, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe we have our ambassadorial performances to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely! Keisuke and Shosuke even said how they really helped increase the park's attendance figures.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And that makes me really happy.
Bit by bit, it's feeling more like the park when Grandpa was still around.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
It's nice to see so many more smiling guests.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Now I get it...
This is why Rui wanted Emu to do this.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hey, you guys!
Can we check out the shop with the lemon-flavored popcorn?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I wanna see it too☆
What color do you think it's gonna be? The soda one was blue, so lemon means yellow, right?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, then... Let's head over that way since it might be less crowded. If I recall, it's just over that way.

rows.Line:
<Woohoo!
Thanks, Nene! Lead the way!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? M-Me? Sure, but...
Rui, Emu, please tell me if I start going the wrong way.

rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Line:
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...

rows.Line: (Also, all the guests seem really happy. I'm really glad we're doing this...)

rows.Line:
Mommy!

rows.Line:
Again?! We just went on it!

rows.Line:

Yes, yes.

rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (The Trampoline Dome, the haunted house, the merry-go-round... All of it was gonna be gone, but...)

rows.Line: (Tsukasa said so himself that time.)

rows.Line: Regardless of operations and visitor totals, everyone that comes here wants to smile!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means there has to be a way for us to reach thousands of people all at once and make them smile!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If Tsukasa hadn't said that, I probably wouldn't have seen those kids smiling just now.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. More people began to visit after we put on more and more shows at the Wonder Stage... However, lately, something seems different about the park, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe we have our ambassadorial performances to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It wasn't just Tsukasa. Everyone helped save Phoenix Wonderland and return it to what it was like when Grandpa was still around—a park that's full of smiles.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
My dream came true because of them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means, I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: S-Sorry, I...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The truth is...
This weird feeling's been lingering inside me ever since Tsukasa began attending that workshop.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He kept getting better and better at acting, which made me really happy. I wanted to cheer him on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When Tsukasa said that he wanted to perform elsewhere in order to make his dream come true, a part of me started to believe that we'd have to say goodbye to each other soon...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was when I began hesitating...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But I understand now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys invited me to hang out with you and see the park to show me the smiles on all our guests' faces.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My dream of seeing Phoenix Wonderland become filled with smiles is within grasp.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And you guys helped make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, now it's my turn!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Since you all encouraged me to achieve my dream, I want to support you guys too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I really don't want us to split up...
That's probably never gonna change.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I want to show my support to Tsukasa, and you guys too, as you all reach for your goals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for telling us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, having to split up is sad...
That feeling's also been lingering inside me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Which made me...

rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Line: However, I arrived at the same conclusion as you two.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it is sad that we're eventually going to have to go our separate ways, but I still want to be supportive of you all as you achieve your dreams.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Line: And I've been thinking of a way to deal with both...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Both? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, excuse me. That part only involves me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I'm glad to see that you're feeling better, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel a lot better now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, moving forward, I'm gonna sit front and center as I cheer you guys on!
song00006_off_f

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You really do look your best when there's a smile on your face, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I think so too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... Is that why you invited me here today? You guys were all worried about me...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, a little.

rows.Line: We noticed that you seemed a little out of sorts lately. We told the others, and Len came up with the idea of inviting you to hang out as a way to cheer you up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to make you guys feel so concerned...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And thank you, Len!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I'm glad this went so well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: About us... Our futures...

rows.Line: Our futures...

rows.Line: (Tsukasa and I want to become actors, and Rui a director. Eventually, we're all gonna have to say goodbye to the Wonder Stage to pursue our goals.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:

rows.Line: We've gotta grab some spots where we can see him really well!

rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Line: Wow...! This place is really nice considering it's only meant for invited guests!

rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't expecting them to be performing in a place like this.

rows.Line: The director at the helm is very famous, so I'm sure he was able to call in a favor to book this venue.

rows.Line:

We should be able to see Tsukasa really well and cheer for him!

rows.Line: This isn't one of those anime cheer screenings...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: What do you think they're gonna do?! Tsukasa said we'd have to wait until the curtains go up, but I'm so excited to see!

rows.Line: So is not performing with you as his director. I'm also pretty excited about...

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line: (Huh? Isn't this...?)

rows.Line: “What?!”

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (It's him... Tsukasa's Peter Pan.)

rows.Line: Wow, so he's the lead...?

rows.Line:
It seems so.
This explains why he stayed quiet until today.

rows.Speaker: Wendy
rows.Line:
“Are you really Peter Pan...?
From that fairytale about Neverland?”

rows.Line:
“Yes, the very same.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
“That means...

rows.Line: “Yes, of course. Not only that...”

rows.Line:
“So can you if you truly believe.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: It's a way to show that he is in fact Peter Pan and knows how to fly. And that he is no ordinary person.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really, it's extraordinary... And yet, it all seems natural. He must've worked very hard to make it appear so...

rows.Line: He learned how to do all that in such a short amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(This is so amazing.
Tsukasa's really shining today.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(So much that I can't look away...

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“So, are you ready?
Again, it's easy. All you have to do is wish as hard as you can. Then...”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line: “You'll be able to fly!”

rows.Line: (I really love Tsukasa's acting style...)

rows.Line: (He always sparkles and puts smiles on everyone's faces whenever he's on stage. So...)

rows.Line: (I'm sure he'll become a world-famous star someday.)

rows.Line: (I'm done hesitating. I'm going to really root for Tsukasa. And...)

rows.Line: For now, the workshop's over and we need to start preparing for our next show at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Line:
